ValidationRule.description: Currency code must be uppercase letters, the system rate for the invoice currency must be positive, and a custom exchange rate must be within 25% of it.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Currency_Code__c)), OR( NOT(REGEX(Currency_Code__c, '[A-Z]{3}')), CURRENCYRATE(Currency_Code__c) <= 0, AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Exchange_Rate__c)), ABS(Exchange_Rate__c - CURRENCYRATE(Currency_Code__c)) > 0.25 * CURRENCYRATE(Currency_Code__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Currency Code or Exchange Rate is invalid.
